results.q: Can Circles help build digital literacy?
results.a: The regular workshops and outreach activities that the Circles Project implements help participants become more comfortable with technology adaptation and learn how they can make digital products useful to their business, personal and family needs.
Yes, the Circles Project is a non-profit digital startup that is currently research ways to support people in meeting their and their family's daily needs.

results.q: Does Circles help people to adapt to technology for the common good and welfare?
results.a: Yes. Circles uses blockchain technology to enhance people ability in meeting their daily needs. By using the Circles app in exchanging goods/services, all Circles users are practicing their technology adaptation on daily basis while working together within their communities to increase the exchange of goods/services based on trust relations.
